intelligence.title: Intelligence layers
intelligence.description: NLU always runs first. Independent fallbacks apply to new requests without restarting. Start model processes separately in the app. Decision requires valid calibration, confidence strictly above 0.50 and margin at least 0.08. Check installation, availability and calibration in AI Lab. Enabled layers use the secure contextual runtime even when legacy mode was selected.

identity_binding.title: Voice identity bindings
identity_binding.description: Choose one satellite OR device and a user. Uncheck Save and finish to add another binding. To remove, select an existing binding or check Remove binding. Authenticated context always wins; users are never chosen automatically.
